# Relevant

> AI-powered personalized intelligence for professionals.

Relevant is a role-aware relevance engine that answers three questions for every news event: What happened, why it matters to this specific user, and what they should do next.

## What Relevant Does

- Monitors news sources relevant to a user's role, company, and industry
- Filters out noise — only surfaces stories with real business impact
- Delivers structured AI briefings with: what happened, why it matters, and what to watch
- Learns from user context (role, goals, competitors) to improve relevance over time
- Saves professionals 11+ hours per week of news consumption time

## How It Works

1. Users set up their professional context — role, company, industry, competitors, and goals
2. Relevant's AI engine continuously monitors thousands of news sources
3. Stories are matched, ranked, and filtered based on personal relevance
4. Each story is delivered as a structured signal with clear business impact analysis
5. Users can tune their feed, save notes, and adjust what matters to them

## Key Features

- **Personalized Feed**: AI-curated news based on your specific role and work context
- **Signal Intelligence**: Each story explains what happened, why it matters to you, and what to do next
- **Time Saved Tracking**: See exactly how much time Relevant saves you each week
- **Goal Coach**: Set professional goals and get news filtered through your priorities
- **Search & Explore**: Find signals across topics relevant to your work
- **Notes**: Save and annotate signals for future reference

## Product Details

- **Platform**: iOS (mobile app)
- **Website**: https://www.getrelevantapp.com
- **Contact**: support@getrelevantapp.com
- **Social**: Instagram @relevant.app, TikTok @relevant.app

## Who It's For

- Executives and decision-makers who need to stay informed without drowning in noise
- Product managers, strategists, and analysts tracking competitive and market signals
- Professionals in fast-moving industries (tech, finance, healthcare, energy)
- Anyone whose work requires staying current but who doesn't have time to read everything

## What Relevant Is NOT

- Not a generic news aggregator or RSS reader
- Not a social media feed
- Not a search engine
- Not a newsletter platform

Relevant is an intelligence layer for work — it tells you only what affects your decisions.
